spotlights.title: From Timid Beginner to National Team Poomsae Medalist
spotlights.story: Sokha joined Infinity Taekwondo as a quiet 14-year-old with zero athletic background. Through 5 years of relentless daily dedication, he mastered all 8 Taegeuk forms and Koryo, going on to earn Gold at the Cambodia National Championships. He now assists Master Sovan in coaching the junior poomsae squad.
spotlights.quote: The Dojang taught me that failure is simply data. Every missed kick is a chance to refine your angle and balance.
spotlights.favoriteTechnique: Koryo Poomsae & Double Side Kick (Yeop Chagi)
spotlights.trainingGoal: Qualify for the Asian Taekwondo Championships 2027

spotlights.title: Junior Champions Team Captain & 540 Kick Pioneer
spotlights.story: At just 11 years old, Chanthy has become one of the youngest students at Infinity TKD to cleanly land a 540 kick on the spring floor. Her academic focus at school and leadership among younger white belt students make her a standout role model in our Little Warriors program.
spotlights.quote: I love breaking boards with flying kicks because it shows that anything is possible if you practice hard!
achievements: Top Academic Honor Student at School
spotlights.trainingGoal: Earn 1st Poom Black Belt before age 12

spotlights.title: Action Cinema Stunt Performer & Tricking Specialist
spotlights.story: Dara leveraged Infinity Taekwondo’s Creative Studio and acrobatic training to transition into professional stunt work, performing in high-profile martial arts short films and commercial campaigns across Southeast Asia.
spotlights.quote: Infinity TKD gives you both the authentic traditional discipline and the modern stage to share your artistry with the world.
achievements: Lead Action Stunt Performer in 3 Southeast Asian Film Projects
Over 1.5M+ Collective Views on Martial Action Shorts
spotlights.trainingGoal: Direct Cambodia’s first international martial arts action series

spotlights.title: Freestyle Musical Poomsae Champion
spotlights.story: Leakhena blends classical World Taekwondo stances with dynamic musical choreography. Her synchronized routines in national tournaments have earned high praise from international referees.
spotlights.quote: When you perform Poomsae to music, every block and kick becomes poetry in motion.
achievements: Gold Medalist - National Youth Freestyle Poomsae 2025
Captain of the Youth Creative Demo Team
spotlights.trainingGoal: Compete in the World Taekwondo Poomsae Championships

spotlights.title: Tech Executive to Dojang Warrior: 25kg Transformation
spotlights.story: Working long hours in front of a computer left Rathana feeling drained and out of shape. Enrolling in adult evening classes at our Kouk Khleang branch, he rebuilt his cardiovascular stamina, lost 25kg, and developed lifelong mental resilience.
spotlights.quote: Martial arts gave me my life and clarity back. Stepping onto the mats resets my mind completely after intense workdays.
achievements: Graduated White to Blue Belt with Honors
Kouk Khleang Adult Cohort Class Representative

spotlights.title: Little Warriors Discipline & Focus Honor Award
spotlights.story: Vannak joined the Little Warriors program with excess energy and difficulty focusing in school. Under the patient guidance of Instructor Sothea, he channeled his energy into martial precision and now leads class warm-ups with pride.
spotlights.quote: I bow to my teacher and my parents because respect makes you strong!
achievements: Fastest Belt Promotion from Yellow to Green Belt
spotlights.trainingGoal: Become a Black Belt like Master Keo Moni
